messages:
alex: Quick predeploy check for the small-batch v2.14 rollout — target 02:00 UTC. Posting a short checklist, pls ack/assign:
- owner for smoke: @maria
- rollback owner: @jong
- no DB migrations, config toggles only
- staging smoke green -> proceed to staggered rollout (10/50/100)

maria: On it, i'll run the smoke suite at 01:45 UTC and watch tailing p50/p95 and error-rate dashboards. :thumbsup:

jong: I'll be on rollback. Snapshot + deployment snapshot in place. Rollback runbook on Confluence -> /deploy/rollback-playbook. I'll keep the rollback cmd ready.

samira: Quick Q — which runtime toggle are we flipping? Is this the runtime3.5 kernel selection or a model-variant switch?

alex: It's a model-variant switch (runtime stays). We'll flip model: redwood-inference/model-v2.14->model-v2.14-stable if we need to fallback. No infra changes.

maria: Smoke steps I'm running (will paste results):
```
# smoke script (internal)
curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt": "smoke-test: latency and correctness check", "max_tokens": 16}' | jq .status
```
I'll post latency p95 and any content diffs.

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: 3125000000 - 3125003600 (02:00 UTC). Canary lane created: canary-v2-14-small-batch.

jong: ACK, i'll be watching errors and traces channel, have rollback command staged: `kubectl apply -f rollout-rollback.yaml -n prod`. If I see error rate > 3% or token-rate drop, I'll execute.

maria: ACK — starting smoke at 01:45. Will report back within 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: Plan: if smoke is green -> kick 10% canary, wait 10m -> 50% -> wait 10m -> 100%. Everyone listed please reply with "Approved" to proceed. Also confirm you can be paged during the window.

maria: Approved. reachable via slack and phone.

jong: Approved. On-call and ready.

samira: Approved. I'll monitor ML metrics and qual checks.

alex: Thanks. Final note: metric thresholds for automatic abort are: latency p95 > +40% from baseline OR error-rate > 2% absolute. If automated abort hits, rollback owner runs the command above.

maria: Smoke finished: p50 120ms p95 340ms error-rate 0.1%. Outputs sanity checks passed. Proceeding to kick 10% canary in 2m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: canary-v2-14-small-batch (10%).

alex: Good luck. Ping here with any anomalies.

maria: Canary 10% healthy after 10m. No spike in errors, traces look clean. Proceed to 50%.

jong: Monitoring. No rollback needed so far.

deploy-bot: Canary updated to 50% at 3125000450.

maria: 50% stable after 10m, moving to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% at 3125000590.

alex: Rollout done. Closing the window unless anyone reports issues in the next 30m. Great job team :tada:
